chunks: Do those who do evil think that they will get the better of Us? How bad is the judgement that they make!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who think they can outpace God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the arrogance of those who believe they can outrun God's knowledge and decree, emphasizing that divine justice is inevitable regardless of human attempts to evade it. It underscores the concept of 'Hikmah' (divine wisdom) in timing retribution, reminding believers that God's delay is not neglect but a measured enactment of justice.
